The '''Veiled Sorority''' was a secretive and matriarchal [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization.

==Description==
[[File:MotPQ_FC_character_art.png|thumb|left|150px|The Pirate Queen of the Veiled Sorority.]]
The Veiled Sorority operated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. The organization was ruled by a [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] who was elected among a council of [[Captain/Legends|captains]] and [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], only [[Gender/Legends|females]]. The queen kept her identity secret and wore an elaborate mask in public. If the queen was [[Death/Legends|killed]], another was chosen and the mask was transmitted to her successor so that most of the Sorority ignored the transfer of power, making the Queen immortal. The Veiled Sorority also kept some anonymity by avoiding drawing attention of authorities in attacking essentially only other criminal groups.<ref name="MotPQ" />

==History==
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] female [[Noira]] was the third Pirate Queen of the Veiled Sorority since its creation. Contrary to the practices of the organization, she decided to focus her attention on one group: the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. This resulted in a violent reprisal from [[Tyber Zann]] and culminated in the death of the Pirate Queen in a [[Battle between Ord Mantell and Genassa|large space battle]].<ref name="MotPQ" />
